name: Personalized Learning & Academic Diagnostics
description: Student competency diagnostics, learning gap identification, drop-off risk prevention, and adaptive study plans.
target_persona: Educator, Academic Counselor, or Self-directed Learner
analysis_focus: Identify conceptual bottlenecks vs execution/practice deficits
Evaluate student mastery against benchmark thresholds
Assess correlation between study habits and exam performance

risk_rules.warning: High risk of subject abandonment or exam failure within the upcoming grading cycle.
Gaps in core prerequisite topics preventing comprehension of advanced modules.
Performance hindered by pacing rather than content mastery.

recommendation_types: Weekly milestone study schedule with spaced repetition
disclaimer: Educational recommendations are designed to complement certified curriculum standards and teacher assessments.
